# ServiceStatus

One row per connected music service (Spotify, TIDAL, Beatport) showing its connection state, account and expiry, and the one action that fixes it.

`SongNodes.ServiceStatus` · Data

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.ServiceStatus service="Spotify" state="connected" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.ServiceStatus" service="Spotify" state="connected"></x-import>
```

## Props (ServiceStatusProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `service` * | `"Spotify" \| "TIDAL" \| "Beatport"` | The connected service. |
| `state` * | `"connected" \| "expired" \| "not-connected" \| "error"` | Connection state. |
| `account` | `string` | Account name when connected. |
| `expiresAt` | `string` | Expiry as an ISO date. |
| `detail` | `string` | What happened and what to do next (expired, error). |
| `onConnect` | `() => void` | Connect or reconnect handler. |
| `onDisconnect` | `() => void` | Disconnect handler. |
